execution_rule: Declare one next action; sequence multiple tasks internally but expose the single highest-value executable action as the next baton.
method: Determine active work by reconciling current main, current GitHub issues/PRs, recent commits, ratified project-intelligence, and latest claim-matched verified evidence; do not use a dated queue as live truth without checking whether newer work superseded it.
priority_rule: Choose work by causal value to the current North Star, not by whichever artifact is easiest to edit.
purpose: The locator rule for determining active work: reconcile live sources, choose by causal value, never freeze a strategic focus into the locator, and expose exactly one next action.
strategic_focus_rule: Do not freeze a strategic focus into this activation locator; resolve the current focus at boot from live work and evidence, then record exactly one next action.
title: CURRENT REALITY / ACTIVE WORK
